name: Aurora Lantern Bridge
description: A graceful arched bridge spanning a frozen lake, lanterns hanging from its cables glowing in sync with the dancing aurora above.
prompt: Night scene: elegant arched bridge of dark wood and steel cables over a mirror‑smooth frozen lake. Hundreds of paper lanterns hang, each emitting a warm glow that mirrors the shifting aurora colors (green, violet, teal). Reflections perfect. 8k, photorealistic, serene.
caption: Cross the night on a ribbon of light. 🌉✨ #AuroraLanternBridge
